LightningComponentBundle.description: Configurable hierarchy viewer for any Case with parent-child relationships. Admins can select which child Case fields to display via component properties.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card Title
property.description: Title displayed on the component card

property.name: childCaseFields
property.label: Child Case Fields (comma-separated)
property.description: Additional Case field API names to display. CaseNumber is always shown first automatically. Examples: Status,Priority,Owner.Name

property.name: showAccountRoles
property.label: Show Account Roles
property.description: Display related Account Roles (contacts associated with financial accounts)

property.name: accountRoleLabel
property.label: Account Role Section Label
property.description: Label for the account roles section (e.g., 'Successors', 'Account Holders', 'Beneficiaries')

property.name: roleFilter
property.label: Role Filter (optional)
property.description: Filter Account Roles by this role name. Leave blank to show all active roles. Use comma-separated values for multiple roles (e.g., 'Successor,Beneficiary')

property.name: excludeStatuses
property.label: Exclude Child Case Statuses (optional)
property.description: Comma-separated list of Case statuses to exclude from display. Examples: Cancelled,Closed,Inactive

property.name: expandFirstChild
property.label: Auto-Expand First Child
property.description: Automatically expand the first child case on load
